mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% annualized rate signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 600,000 units signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between HOUST and SPX 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with increasing INDPRO and decreasing UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) signals a benign monetary environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with CPIAUCSL < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing retail sales (RSAFS) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances with increasing RSAFS and decreasing UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 100,000 signals a labor market slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of post-shock recovery instances with PAYEMS below 100,000.
